# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Omazen to be a welcoming, respectful, and technically constructive
project for everyone. We pledge to make participation in this project and our
community an experience free from harassment, discrimination, and intimidation,
regardless of background, identity, experience, or personal characteristics.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contribute to a positive environment include:

- Being respectful, patient, and considerate.
- Giving and receiving feedback constructively.
- Focusing on the issue, the evidence, and the needs of the project.
- Respecting different viewpoints and experiences.
- Taking responsibility for mistakes and correcting them openly.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, personal attacks,
sexualized language or attention, threats, deliberate disruption, publishing
someone else's private information, and any other conduct that would reasonably
make participation unsafe or unwelcome.

## Enforcement responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing this Code of
Conduct. They may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, issues, pull
requests, or other contributions that violate these standards, and may take
appropriate action when necessary.

## Reporting

Please report unacceptable behavior privately to the repository maintainers
through GitHub. Do not open a public issue for sensitive reports. Include enough
context to understand what happened, along with links or other evidence when
available.

Reports will be reviewed as promptly and fairly as possible. Retaliation
against anyone who makes a good-faith report will not be tolerated.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within project spaces and whenever someone is
officially representing the project or its community.
